## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon Andrews saved [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) from a potential disaster by catching her by her sash before she could fall overboard. However, they do not interact directly during the event surrounding the missing brooch and the church picnic.
